commons.title: Family of Pedro Encinales.png
commons.description: Family of Pedro Encinales, a Miguelino Salinan man born circa, 1860. He was describe as one of the last indians of Mission San Antonio de Padua. More information on Encinales at http://cola.calpoly.edu/~tljones/Walking%20on%20Deer%20Trails.pdf
commons.editorial_reason: Caption specifically identifies a Salinan family, but the photo shows ordinary period Western clothing without distinct Salinan cultural dress, adornment, objects, architecture, or practice.
